_note: Chapter 02 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: He has a remarkable ability to pick up a new language quickly.
ex.cn: 他有极强的能力，很快就能学会一门新语言。
ex.note: the ability to do sth. 做某事的能力；have the ability to do 有能力做

ex.en: The work was carried out in accordance with the safety rules.
ex.cn: 这项工作是按照安全规程进行的。
ex.note: in accordance with 与…一致；依照

ex.en: It took him a month to adapt to life in the dormitory.
ex.cn: 他花了一个月才适应宿舍里的生活。
ex.note: adapt to 适应；adapt A into B 把 A 改编成 B

ex.en: At first she was afraid to speak English in front of the class.
ex.cn: 起初她不敢在全班面前说英语。
ex.note: be afraid of 害怕；be afraid to do 不敢做

ex.en: His parents send him a monthly allowance of two hundred yuan.
ex.cn: 父母每月给他两百元零用钱。
ex.note: make an allowance for 考虑到；a daily allowance 每日津贴

ex.en: His ancestors had all been fishermen in the northern village.
ex.cn: 他的祖辈都是北方村子里的渔民。
ex.note: one's ancestors 祖先；forefathers 先辈

ex.en: Apart from Mark and Sarah, David had made a few other friends.
ex.cn: 除了马克和萨拉，大卫还交了几个别的朋友。
ex.note: apart from 除…之外；set apart 分开；come apart 散开

ex.en: The reading area of the library was quiet and full of light.
ex.cn: 图书馆的阅览区安静而明亮。
ex.note: in the area of 在…一带；the area of … …的面积

ex.en: The new library is a real asset to the whole campus.
ex.cn: 这座新图书馆是整个校园的宝贵财富。
ex.note: an asset to 对…是宝贵财富

ex.en: A charity auction of old books raised money for the village library.
ex.cn: 一场旧书义卖为村图书馆筹到了钱。
ex.note: at auction 在拍卖中；hold an auction 举行拍卖

ex.en: He slung his bag over his shoulder and walked toward the gate.
ex.cn: 他把包往肩上一甩，朝门口走去。
ex.note: a shoulder bag 挎包；a bag of 一袋

ex.en: All the courses are ranked on the basis of difficulty.
ex.cn: 所有课程都按难度分档。
ex.note: on the basis of 以…为基础；the basis for … …的基础

ex.en: The new term will begin on the first Monday of September.
ex.cn: 新学期从九月的第一个星期一开始。
ex.note: begin with/from 以…开始；begin to do 开始做

ex.en: The whole registration process was moved into the big gym.
ex.cn: 整个注册流程被搬进了大体育馆。
ex.note: a big deal 大事；big on 热衷于

ex.en: A cold wind began to blow through the open windows.
ex.cn: 冷风开始从开着的窗户灌进来。
ex.note: blow away 吹走；blow up 爆炸

ex.en: He received a hard blow on the shoulder in the practice match.
ex.cn: 练习赛里他的肩膀挨了重重一击。
ex.note: a blow to 对…的打击；deal a blow 给予打击

ex.en: The old librarian bowed slightly and handed the book across the desk.
ex.cn: 老图书管理员微微欠身，把书递过桌面。
ex.note: bow to sb. 向某人鞠躬；bow one's head 低头

ex.en: Each archer tested his bow before the competition began.
ex.cn: 比赛开始前，每位射箭手都试了试自己的弓。
ex.note: a bow and arrow 弓箭；tie a bow 打蝴蝶结

ex.en: She wore a brown coat with her blue jeans.
ex.cn: 她穿着牛仔裤，配一件棕色外套。
ex.note: brown bread 黑面包；go brown 变黑

ex.en: Behind her desk stood a cabinet full of old files.
ex.cn: 她办公桌后面立着一个装满旧档案的柜子。
ex.note: a cabinet minister 内阁大臣；cabinet 文件柜

ex.en: They took the bus into town because neither of them had a car.
ex.cn: 他们坐公交进城，因为两个人都没有车。
ex.note: by car 乘车；car park 停车场

ex.en: He was cautious as always and read the notice twice.
ex.cn: 他像往常一样谨慎，把告示读了两遍。
ex.note: be cautious about 对…谨慎；cautious to do 谨慎地做

ex.en: The last chapter of the book explains how to build the device.
ex.cn: 这本书的最后一章讲了如何制作那个装置。
ex.note: a chapter in … …中的一章；chapter and verse 原文

ex.en: He rested his chin on his hand and looked out of the window.
ex.cn: 他用手托着下巴，望向窗外。
ex.note: chin up 打起精神；keep your chin up 别灰心

ex.en: He met his first classmate while waiting in the registration line.
ex.cn: 他在注册队伍里等着时遇见了第一个同班同学。
ex.note: a classmate of sb. 某人的同班同学

ex.en: She put on her brown coat before going out into the wind.
ex.cn: 出门迎着风之前，她套上那件棕色外套。
ex.note: raincoat 雨衣；a coat of paint 一层漆

ex.en: The old table was coated with a thin layer of dust.
ex.cn: 那张旧桌子上覆着一层薄薄的灰。
ex.note: be coated with 覆盖着；coat sth. with sth. 用…涂抹

ex.en: A student commission organized the whole club fair.
ex.cn: 整场社团招新会由一个学生委员会组织。
ex.note: a commission 委员会；on commission 按佣金

ex.en: He handed in a short composition about his first week at university.
ex.cn: 他交上一篇关于大学第一周的短文。
ex.note: a written composition 一篇作文；musical composition 乐曲

ex.en: The clerk checked the form and confirmed his name.
ex.cn: 办事员核对了表格，确认了他的姓名。
ex.note: confirm a booking 确认预订；confirm that … 证实

ex.en: You should consult your advisor before choosing your courses.
ex.cn: 选课之前你应该咨询自己的导师。
ex.note: consult sb. on sth. 就某事咨询某人；consult a dictionary 查词典

ex.en: Words on paper can never fully convey how much he missed home.
ex.cn: 纸上的字永远无法完全传达他有多想家。
ex.note: convey a message 传达信息；convey feelings 表达感情

ex.en: He had learned to count every coin his family earned.
ex.cn: 他早就学会把家里挣的每一枚硬币都算清楚。
ex.note: count on 指望；count as 被算作；count for little 不重要

ex.en: On the first day the count of new students reached two thousand.
ex.cn: 第一天，新生的人数就达到了两千。
ex.note: at the final count 最终清点；not count 算不了

ex.en: The officer talked about how to prevent crime on campus.
ex.cn: 那位警官讲的是如何预防校园里的犯罪。
ex.note: commit a crime 犯罪；a crime against 针对…的罪行

ex.en: The current policy allows students to change courses once a term.
ex.cn: 现行规定允许学生每学期改选一次课程。
ex.note: current price 时价；current affairs 时事

ex.en: The small device measures the current flowing through the wire.
ex.cn: 这个小小的装置测量流过导线的电流。
ex.note: alternating current 交流电；the current 潮流

ex.en: Daylight poured through the high windows onto the desks.
ex.cn: 阳光从高窗倾泻到书桌上。
ex.note: in broad daylight 光天化日；daylight hours 白天

ex.en: Their team was defeated in the first practice match.
ex.cn: 他们队在第一场练习赛中被打败了。
ex.note: be defeated by 败给；defeat sb. 击败某人

ex.en: The defeat did not depress the team for long.
ex.cn: 那场失利并没有让球队消沉多久。
ex.note: suffer a defeat 遭受失败；a crushing defeat 惨败

ex.en: The news of the defeat depressed him for the whole evening.
ex.cn: 失利的消息让他低落了一整个晚上。
ex.note: depress sb. 使某人沮丧；be depressed 使沮丧

ex.en: The two students devised a small device to measure current.
ex.cn: 两个学生设计出一个测量电流的小装置。
ex.note: devise a plan 想出计划；devise a way of doing 想出…的办法

ex.en: A notice on the wall gave the directions to the registration desk.
ex.cn: 墙上的告示写着去注册柜台的指引。
ex.note: in the direction of 朝…方向；under the direction of 在…指导下

ex.en: Every club displayed photographs of its past activities.
ex.cn: 每个社团都展出了以往活动的照片。
ex.note: display sth. for sale 展示…待售；on display 展出

ex.en: A large display of old photographs filled one wall of the hall.
ex.cn: 大厅的一整面墙都是老照片的展示。
ex.note: on display 展出；display screen 显示屏幕

ex.en: The domain of engineering may really belong to him after all.
ex.cn: 工程的领域或许真的属于他。
ex.note: the domain of … …的领域；domain name 域名

ex.en: Sarah, in a blue dress, was running the book stall.
ex.cn: 萨拉穿着一条蓝裙子，正在照看旧书摊。
ex.note: an evening dress 晚礼服；dress clothes 礼服

ex.en: The children dressed quickly and ran out to the sports field.
ex.cn: 孩子们很快穿好衣服，跑到运动场上去。
ex.note: get dressed 穿好衣服；dress oneself 给自己穿衣

ex.en: The university eagle was printed on the badge of every club president.
ex.cn: 每位社团主席的徽章上都印着学校的鹰徽。
ex.note: the eagle 校徽

ex.en: The coach told them that effort counts more than ability.
ex.cn: 教练告诉他们，努力比天赋更重要。
ex.note: make an effort 努力；with effort 努力地

ex.en: The best ideas often emerge from the simplest materials.
ex.cn: 最好的想法往往出自最简单的材料。
ex.note: emerge from 从…中浮现；emerge as 成为

ex.en: The weekly workshop helps students enhance their spoken English.
ex.cn: 每周的工作坊帮助学生提高英语口语。
ex.note: enhance quality 提高质量；enhance one's reputation 提升声誉

ex.en: He enjoyed the science workshop, especially the long experiments.
ex.cn: 他喜欢科学工作坊，尤其是那些漫长的实验。
ex.note: especially 尤其；not especially 不怎么

ex.en: The professor examined their device and nodded in approval.
ex.cn: 教授端详着他们做的装置，点了点头表示认可。
ex.note: examine a student 考查学生；examine carefully 仔细检查

ex.en: The first experiment turned out to be the most memorable of the term.
ex.cn: 第一次实验成了这一学期最难忘的一课。
ex.note: carry out an experiment 做实验；experiment on 在…上做实验

ex.en: They experimented with a volt and a tank of water before the real lesson.
ex.cn: 在正式上课之前，他们用一伏电压和一箱水试了试。
ex.note: experiment with 尝试；experiment on 对…进行实验

ex.en: The colours of the old posters had begun to fade.
ex.cn: 那些旧海报的颜色开始褪去。
ex.note: fade away 逐渐消失；fade into 渐渐融入

ex.en: She fastened the parcel with string and a roll of tape.
ex.cn: 她用麻绳和一卷胶带把包裹捆好。
ex.note: fasten sth. to sth. 把…系在…上；fasten a seat belt 系好安全带

ex.en: It took ten minutes to fetch a book from the closed shelves.
ex.cn: 从闭架书架上取一本书要花十分钟。
ex.note: fetch sth. for sb. 为某人取来；fetch up 带来

ex.en: He clenched his fist and decided to believe the coach.
ex.cn: 他攥紧拳头，决定相信教练的话。
ex.note: clench one's fist 攥紧拳头；fist in one's glove 戴手套的拳头

ex.en: She followed the directions on the notice and found the desk easily.
ex.cn: 她照着告示上的指引，很容易就找到了那个柜台。
ex.note: follow instructions 遵照指示；as follows 如下

ex.en: Fortunately, the coach was patient with the beginners.
ex.cn: 幸好教练对新手很有耐心。
ex.note: fortunately for sb. 幸亏某人

ex.en: The first frost of the year touched the garden in the night.
ex.cn: 一年里的第一场霜在夜里落在了花园上。
ex.note: a heavy frost 大霜；frost over 结霜

ex.en: They walked across the garden to the registration hall.
ex.cn: 他们穿过花园走向注册大厅。
ex.note: garden city 花园城市；gardening 园艺

ex.en: He was glad to hear that his mother had received the letter.
ex.cn: 听说母亲收到了信，他很高兴。
ex.note: be glad to do 乐意做；be glad of/about 因…而高兴

ex.en: She spoke with an easy grace that made the queue seem shorter.
ex.cn: 她说话带着一种从容的优雅，让队伍都显得短了。
ex.note: with grace 优雅地；a grace period 宽限期

ex.en: The daily grind of classes and sport made the weekends feel short.
ex.cn: 上课和运动的日常磨砺让周末显得很短。
ex.note: the daily grind 日常的苦差；grind coffee 磨咖啡

ex.en: He asked for a hammer and a screwdriver before starting.
ex.cn: 动手之前他要来一把锤子和一把螺丝刀。
ex.note: a hammer blow 锤击；hammer and tongs 地毯式打击

ex.en: He hammered the nail into the board with two careful blows.
ex.cn: 他小心地敲了两下，把钉子钉进了木板。
ex.note: hammer at 敲打；hammer out 敲出；hammer away 埋头苦干

ex.en: The noise in the reading room gave him a terrible headache.
ex.cn: 阅览室的噪音让他疼得厉害。
ex.note: give sb. a headache 让某人头痛；a splitting headache 剧烈头痛

ex.en: The captain, the hero of the team, finally smiled at him.
ex.cn: 队长——全队的英雄——终于对他笑了一下。
ex.note: a hero in sb.'s eyes 某人眼中的英雄

ex.en: He finished his English homework before going to bed.
ex.cn: 他睡前做完了英语作业。
ex.note: do one's homework 做作业；homework on 关于…的作业

ex.en: It was human nature to want to win the match.
ex.cn: 想赢下这场比赛，本就是人的天性。
ex.note: human nature 人的天性；human being 人

ex.en: No machine can replace the human touch in teaching.
ex.cn: 没有任何机器能取代教学中属于人的那一份温度。
ex.note: a human being 人；human intelligence 人的智能

ex.en: His grandmother's illness kept her in bed for several weeks.
ex.cn: 祖母生病卧床了好几个星期。
ex.note: a minor illness 小病；serious illness 重病

ex.en: The box was no larger than a foot across and six inches high.
ex.cn: 那盒子不过一尺见方、六英寸高。
ex.note: at this rate 照这样下去；inch by inch 一点一点地

ex.en: The professor was an influential man with a quick smile.
ex.cn: 那位教授是个有影响力的人，笑容总是很爽利。
ex.note: be influential in 在…中有影响力；an influential figure 重要人物

ex.en: He graduated from the institute of engineering last summer.
ex.cn: 去年夏天他从工程学院毕业。
ex.note: a research institute 研究所；institute of … …的机构

ex.en: The university instituted a free course on computer skills.
ex.cn: 学校设立了一门免费的计算机技能课程。
ex.note: institute a rule 制定规则

ex.en: He put the folded map of the campus into his pocket.
ex.cn: 他把折好的校园地图塞进口袋。
ex.note: into 表示动作方向或状态变化；turn into 变成

ex.en: She was wearing jeans and a brown coat that morning.
ex.cn: 那天早上她穿着牛仔裤和一件棕色外套。
ex.note: a pair of jeans 一条牛仔裤；jean jacket 牛仔夹克

ex.en: Type quietly on the keyboard so as not to wake the room.
ex.cn: 打字时轻一点，别惊动整间屋子。
ex.note: on the keyboard 在键盘上；keyboard operator 键盘操作员

ex.en: A hundred lamps along the desks were waiting for the evening.
ex.cn: 书桌旁的一百盏灯正等着夜晚。
ex.note: a desk lamp 台灯；turn on the lamp 开灯

ex.en: She was a leading professor at the institute of engineering.
ex.cn: 她是工程学院的一位资深教授。
ex.note: a leading figure 领军人物；leading role 主角

ex.en: Every student has the liberty to change direction after the first year.
ex.cn: 每个学生在大一之后都有改变方向的权利。
ex.note: at liberty 自由地；take the liberty 擅自

ex.en: He has lived on campus for three years now.
ex.cn: 他在这所学校的宿舍里已经住了三年。
ex.note: live in 居住；live on 以…为生

ex.en: Even students who could not afford a ticket watched the live broadcast.
ex.cn: 连买不起票的学生也看了现场直播。
ex.note: live broadcast 现场直播；live animals 活体动物

ex.en: He spent a lovely afternoon reading in the library.
ex.cn: 他在图书馆里度过了一个美好的下午。
ex.note: lovely weather 好天气；look lovely 好看

ex.en: The majority of first-year students are still unsure of their subjects.
ex.cn: 大多数一年级学生还没想好自己的专业。
ex.note: the majority of … …的大多数；an absolute majority 绝对多数

ex.en: The best ideas often emerge from the simplest materials.
ex.cn: 最好的想法往往出自最简单的材料。
ex.note: raw materials 原材料；building materials 建筑材料

ex.en: The decision turned out to be material to the whole project.
ex.cn: 这个决定后来证明对整个项目至关重要。
ex.note: be material to 对…重要

ex.en: The membership fees of all the clubs were quite low.
ex.cn: 所有社团的会费都很低。
ex.note: membership fee 会费；take out membership 取得会员资格

ex.en: The blue bag on the desk is mine, and the brown one is hers.
ex.cn: 桌上那个蓝包是我的，那个棕色的才是她的。
ex.note: mine = my one；my + 名词 = 我的…

ex.en: The village had once been famous for the coal mine nearby.
ex.cn: 这个村子曾经因附近的煤矿而闻名。
ex.note: coal mine 煤矿；a mine of wealth 聚宝盆

ex.en: The workers mined coal here for more than fifty years.
ex.cn: 工人们在这里采煤五十多年。
ex.note: mine for gold 开采金矿；mine the sea 布雷

ex.en: For a moment the noise of the campus faded away.
ex.cn: 有那么一会儿，校园的喧闹退远了。
ex.note: at the moment 此刻；for a moment 片刻

ex.en: The movie club had a display of posters of old films.
ex.cn: 电影社的桌上摆着老电影的海报。
ex.note: movie star 电影明星；watch a movie 看电影

ex.en: Naturally, the new president became the victim of endless practical jokes.
ex.cn: 自然，新主席成了没完没了的恶作剧的笑柄。
ex.note: naturally 自然地；naturally enough 果然

ex.en: Her letter was full of small news from the village.
ex.cn: 她的信里全是村里的零零碎碎的消息。
ex.note: a piece of news 一条消息；make news 引起轰动

ex.en: He wrote the whole speech down in his notebook.
ex.cn: 他把那整段话都记在了笔记本上。
ex.note: notebook computer 笔记本电脑

ex.en: It was obvious that most students had come for the free tea.
ex.cn: 显然，多数学生是冲着免费茶水来的。
ex.note: be obvious to sb. 对某人很明显

ex.en: You can search the whole catalogue online in the reading room.
ex.cn: 在阅览室里你就能在线检索整个书目。
ex.note: online shopping 网购；go online 上网

ex.en: He found an original edition of an old engineering text.
ex.cn: 他找到了一本旧工程书的初版初印本。
ex.note: the original version 原版；original sin 原罪

ex.en: The library keeps the original of the oldest map in a glass case.
ex.cn: 图书馆把最古老地图的原件保存在玻璃柜里。
ex.note: the original 原件；original author 原作者

ex.en: There is still one hundred yuan owing on his account.
ex.cn: 他的账上还欠着一百元。
ex.note: owing to 由于；be owing to sb. 欠某人

ex.en: A parcel from home arrived for him in September.
ex.cn: 九月，家里寄来的一个包裹到了他手上。
ex.note: parcel post 包裹邮件；a parcel of land 一块地

ex.en: The cat had injured one of its front paws.
ex.cn: 那只猫有一条前爪受了伤。
ex.note: a cat's paw 猫爪；paw at 用爪子抓

ex.en: The card was his permanent pass to the library.
ex.cn: 那张卡是他在图书馆的永久通行证。
ex.note: a permanent job 长期职位；permanent address 固定住址

ex.en: Her apple pie won a prize at the village fair.
ex.cn: 她的苹果派在乡村集市上拿了奖。
ex.note: apple pie 苹果派；pie in the sky 空想

ex.en: The whole class was pleased with the little device they had made.
ex.cn: 全班都对他们做出来的那个小装置很满意。
ex.note: be pleased with 对…满意；be pleased to do 乐意做

ex.en: His grandparents were poor but proud of their family.
ex.cn: 他的祖父母虽然贫穷，却为这个家庭感到自豪。
ex.note: the poor 穷人；poor in 缺乏

ex.en: He remembered the poverty of his childhood without bitterness.
ex.cn: 他想起童年的贫穷，心里却没有一丝苦涩。
ex.note: live in poverty 生活贫困；absolute poverty 绝对贫困

ex.en: The device was not pretty, but it worked perfectly.
ex.cn: 那个装置不好看，却管用得很。
ex.note: a pretty mess 一团糟；pretty much 几乎

ex.en: The queue now moved pretty fast after the desk was opened.
ex.cn: 窗口一开，队伍就走得相当快了。
ex.note: pretty well 相当好；pretty much 几乎

ex.en: The market sells fresh products from the farms nearby.
ex.cn: 市场出售附近农场的新鲜农产品。
ex.note: a product of 是…的产物；local products 土特产

ex.en: His parents were proud of what he had achieved in his first year.
ex.cn: 父母为他在第一年做出的成绩感到自豪。
ex.note: be proud of 为…自豪；proud to do 乐意做

ex.en: The card is your qualification for everything on this campus.
ex.cn: 这张卡就是你在整个校园里办事的凭证。
ex.note: qualification for … …的资格；academic qualifications 学历

ex.en: The courses are ranked according to their difficulty.
ex.cn: 这些课程是按难度分档的。
ex.note: hold the rank of 担任…军衔；a high rank 高级别

ex.en: The two teams were ranked second and third last season.
ex.cn: 上赛季这两支队伍分别排在第二和第三。
ex.note: rank among 位列…之中；rank high 排名靠前

ex.en: The class measured a volt with an old radio receiver.
ex.cn: 全班用一台旧收音机接收器测了一伏电压。
ex.note: a radio receiver 无线电接收机；the receiver 接收者

ex.en: The notice gave the directions regarding the registration desk.
ex.cn: 告示上写着关于注册柜台的指引。
ex.note: regarding = about 关于

ex.en: He remembered his childhood without any bitterness.
ex.cn: 他回望童年，没有一丝苦涩。
ex.note: remember to do 记得去做；remember doing 记得做过

ex.en: The club president resigned in October, and Mark took his place.
ex.cn: 十月社团主席辞职了，马克接替了他的位置。
ex.note: resign from 辞去；resign oneself to 听任

ex.en: The reward for his first month was a bottle of water and a nod.
ex.cn: 他第一个月得到的回报是一瓶水和一下点头。
ex.note: as a reward for 作为…的回报；no reward 不值得

ex.en: The coach rewarded the whole team for its effort with a free dinner.
ex.cn: 教练请全队吃了一顿免费晚餐，奖励他们的努力。
ex.note: reward sb. for sth. 因某事奖励某人

ex.en: There was scarce room for complaint in that busy week.
ex.cn: 那样忙碌的一周里，几乎没有抱怨的余地。
ex.note: room to do 有做…的余地；make room for 给…腾地方

ex.en: The officer said that safety was a habit, not a gift.
ex.cn: 那位警官说，安全是一种习惯，不是一份礼物。
ex.note: safety rules 安全规定；safety first 安全第一

ex.en: Fresh fruit was scarce in the village before the harvest.
ex.cn: 收获季节之前，村里很少有新鲜水果。
ex.note: scarce resources 稀缺资源；make scarce 变得稀少

ex.en: He carried the book to a seat by the window.
ex.cn: 他抱着书走到窗边的一个座位。
ex.note: take a seat 坐下；a seat of learning 学术中心

ex.en: The big hall can seat five hundred students.
ex.cn: 那个大礼堂能容纳五百名学生。
ex.note: be seated 坐下；seat 800 people 可容纳八百人

ex.en: The professor explained the sequence of courses for the first year.
ex.cn: 教授讲解了第一年课程的先后顺序。
ex.note: a sequence of events 一连串事件；in sequence 依次

ex.en: Mark's family have kept sheep on the farm for three generations.
ex.cn: 马克家在这片农场上养羊已经三代了。
ex.note: a flock of sheep 一群羊；单复数同形

ex.en: On the northern side of the field, an officer gave a short talk.
ex.cn: 在运动场北边，一位警官做了个简短讲座。
ex.note: on the side of 在…一边；on the other hand 另一方面

ex.en: Six desks had been set up in a straight line in the gym.
ex.cn: 体育馆里一字排开摆着六张桌子。
ex.note: six o'clock 六点钟；at six 在六点

ex.en: The captain finally smiled at him and said nothing at all.
ex.cn: 队长终于对他笑了一下，什么也没说。
ex.note: smile at sb. 对某人微笑；a broad smile 灿烂的笑容

ex.en: Somehow the room had already become his home.
ex.cn: 不知怎么，那间宿舍已经成了他的家。
ex.note: somehow or other 不管怎样

ex.en: A speaker on a stand repeated the instructions every few minutes.
ex.cn: 立在架子上的喇叭每隔几分钟就把同样的说明重复一遍。
ex.note: a guest speaker 客座讲者；an loudspeaker 扬声器

ex.en: Every sport had a table of its own at the club fair.
ex.cn: 社团招新会上，每项运动都有一张自己的桌子。
ex.note: take part in sports 参加体育运动；a sports meeting 运动会

ex.en: He had come that morning to confirm his student status.
ex.cn: 那天早上他来办的就是确认学生身份。
ex.note: social status 社会地位；status symbol 身份象征

ex.en: A degree is not a straight road; it is more like a triangle.
ex.cn: 学位不是一条直路，更像一个三角形。
ex.note: keep a straight face 面不改色；straight ahead 一直向前

ex.en: He walked straight into the hall without stopping at the door.
ex.cn: 他径直走进大厅，连门都没停一下。
ex.note: straight away 立刻；straight through 直接穿过

ex.en: She asked each student what subject he wanted to study.
ex.cn: 她一个一个地问每个学生想学什么专业。
ex.note: on the subject of 关于；subject to 受…支配

ex.en: The old bridge was subjected to heavy tests before it was opened.
ex.cn: 这座旧桥在通车前接受了严格的检验。
ex.note: be subjected to 使遭受；受制于

ex.en: For a moment he was alone with the book, the sunlight and the quiet.
ex.cn: 有那么一会儿，只剩下他和那本书、那道阳光，和一片安静。
ex.note: in the sunlight 在阳光下；bathe in sunlight 沐浴在阳光中

ex.en: His will to sustain the effort never faded.
ex.cn: 他要把这股劲儿撑下去的意志从未消退。
ex.note: sustain an effort 维持努力；sustain damage 造成损害

ex.en: The class measured a volt with an old receiver and a tank of water.
ex.cn: 全班用一台旧接收器和一箱水测量了一伏电压。
ex.note: a tank of water 一箱水；fuel tank 油箱

ex.en: He tended to get lost in the laboratory building.
ex.cn: 他常常在实验楼里迷路。
ex.note: tend to do 往往会；tend to 照料

ex.en: There was even a charity auction of old books at the fair.
ex.cn: 招新会上甚至还有一场旧书义卖。
ex.note: there is/are 有；there must be 一定有

ex.en: Daylight poured through the high windows onto the desks.
ex.cn: 阳光从高窗倾泻到书桌上。
ex.note: through the whole night 整夜；go through 经历

ex.en: The first training session left him with a headache and a stubbed toe.
ex.cn: 第一次训练让他头痛未消，脚趾还磕破了。
ex.note: stub one's toe 撞伤脚趾；toe to toe 脚尖对脚尖

ex.en: A guest speaker talked about the trade of writing.
ex.cn: 一位客座讲者谈起了写作这一行。
ex.note: the trade 行业；a trade of 一次交易；trade mark 商标

ex.en: The two countries traded goods under a new agreement.
ex.cn: 两国根据新协议互相交换货物。
ex.note: trade sth. for sth. 用…交换…；trade in 以旧换新

ex.en: The professor said a degree is a triangle with three sides.
ex.cn: 教授说，学位是一个三角形，有三条边。
ex.note: a right triangle 直角三角形；a triangle of … …的三方关系

ex.en: The notice was printed in a type that was hard to read.
ex.cn: 那张告示用的字体很难辨认。
ex.note: this type of 这种；blood type 血型

ex.en: He typed the whole report in less than an hour.
ex.cn: 他不到一个小时就把整份报告打了出来。
ex.note: type sth. into 把…键入；type away 滔滔不绝地打字

ex.en: The football team united the whole dormitory.
ex.cn: 足球队把整栋宿舍楼凝聚在了一起。
ex.note: unite A with B 把…联合起来；unite to do 团结起来做

ex.en: You must learn to utilize the online catalogue first.
ex.cn: 你得先学会使用在线书目。
ex.note: utilize every chance 利用每一个机会；utilize resources 充分利用资源

ex.en: The new president became the victim of a dozen practical jokes.
ex.cn: 新主席成了十几个恶作剧的笑柄。
ex.note: fall victim to 成为…的牺牲品；a victim of crime 犯罪受害者

ex.en: The class learned to measure a volt with a simple circuit.
ex.cn: 全班学会了用一个简单的电路测量一伏电压。
ex.note: high voltage 高压；a volt 一伏

ex.en: He was weak at volleyball and even weaker at running.
ex.cn: 他排球打得很弱，跑步更弱。
ex.note: weak in 在…方面弱；weak point 弱点

ex.en: Whatever you need, we can find it in the library.
ex.cn: 不管你需要什么，我们都能在图书馆里找到。
ex.note: whatever = no matter what 无论什么；whatever happens 无论发生什么

ex.en: The library will open its doors to the new students next week.
ex.cn: 下周图书馆将向新生开放。
ex.note: will 表示将来或意愿；will not 缩写为 won't

ex.en: His will to succeed never faded, whatever happened.
ex.cn: 无论发生什么，他想要成功的意志从未消退。
ex.note: with a will 意志坚定；make a will 立遗嘱

ex.en: The English workshop meets once a week to improve spoken English.
ex.cn: 英语工作坊每周聚一次，以提高英语口语。
ex.note: a workshop on 关于…的研讨会；run a workshop 举办工作坊

ex.en: Yesterday he had been a stranger here, and today the desk was his.
ex.cn: 昨天他还只是这里的陌生人，今天这张书桌就是他的了。
ex.note: the day before yesterday 前天；yesterday morning 昨天上午
